Our two 'problem merchants' for support don't actually need more support staff: once you strip out known delivery-carrier incidents, their ticket performance is as good or better than our top merchant (Marrowby & Vane 22.5% vs. Cragsley's 29.8% breach rate; Studio Vrij just 7.0%).

Marrowby & Vane's support slowdown is a live carrier problem, not a people problem: Albion Parcel's on-time rate at that merchant collapsed from ~80-90% to 36.5% in November, and shipments are still stuck as of year-end — needs a carrier/ops fix, not hiring.

We can't trust our 'how much agents rely on canned replies' number: the top 5 macros show 37,000+ lifetime uses combined but zero corresponding audit-log records — we're dropping that metric from reporting until engineering can explain what it's actually counting.
